# Frozen workflow v1 — do not edit

Everything under `plugins/sunstack-workflow-v1/` is a frozen legacy archive, including skills, references, schemas, metadata and the six copied shared references.

Do not fix, improve, refactor, regenerate, reformat, bump versions or synchronize files here during ordinary development. Reading and using the archive does not authorize changing it.

Put improvements in the maintained `sunstack-dev` base or a separately commissioned future workflow. A defect in v1 is evidence to report, not implicit permission to repair the archive.

Change this archive only when the owner explicitly names archive maintenance and its scope. An instruction to edit the base, change another plugin, clean up references or make checks pass does not grant that permission. Keep any authorized exception narrow and record it with the change.

The initial owner-authorized split is based on main `7ca78ef6`; this archive preserves the legacy workflow with the path and namespace repairs needed for the split. These instructions are an editing boundary, not an assertion of filesystem enforcement.
